list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_classes AS (
    SELECT
        t.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        t.latch_class
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = t.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, srv.name, t.latch_class
    ORDER BY SUM(t.delta_wait_time_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        c.server_label,
        t.latch_class,
        t.collection_time,
        t.delta_wait_time_ms AS delta_value,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', t.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(t.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.server_id, t.latch_class
                ORDER BY t.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    JOIN top_classes AS c
      ON c.server_id = t.server_id
     AND c.latch_class = t.latch_class
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    server_label || ' - ' || latch_class AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_value::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH top_classes AS (
    SELECT
        t.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        t.spinlock_name
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = t.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, srv.name, t.spinlock_name
    ORDER BY SUM(t.delta_collisions) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        c.server_label,
        t.spinlock_name,
        t.collection_time,
        t.delta_collisions AS delta_value,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', t.collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(t.collection_time) OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.server_id, t.spinlock_name
                ORDER BY t.collection_time)))) AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    JOIN top_classes AS c
      ON c.server_id = t.server_id
     AND c.spinlock_name = t.spinlock_name
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    server_label || ' - ' || spinlock_name AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN interval_seconds > 0
        THEN delta_value::double precision / interval_seconds
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM windowed
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        t.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        MAX(t.collection_time) AS mx
    FROM collect.v_latch_stats AS t
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = t.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, srv.name
)
SELECT
    l.server_label AS "Server",
    t.latch_class AS "Latch Class",
    t.waiting_requests_count AS "Waiting Requests",
    t.wait_time_ms AS "Wait Time (ms)",
    t.max_wait_time_ms AS "Max Wait Time (ms)",
    t.delta_waiting_requests_count AS "Waiting Requests (delta)",
    t.delta_wait_time_ms AS "Wait Time (delta ms)"
FROM latest AS l
JOIN collect.v_latch_stats AS t
  ON t.server_id = l.server_id
 AND t.collection_time = l.mx
ORDER BY t.delta_wait_time_ms DESC, t.wait_time_ms DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        t.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        MAX(t.collection_time) AS mx
    FROM collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = t.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collection_time)
      AND t.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY t.server_id, srv.name
)
SELECT
    l.server_label AS "Server",
    t.spinlock_name AS "Spinlock",
    t.collisions AS "Collisions",
    t.spins AS "Spins",
    t.spins_per_collision AS "Spins per Collision",
    t.sleep_time AS "Sleep Time",
    t.backoffs AS "Backoffs",
    t.delta_collisions AS "Collisions (delta)",
    t.delta_spins AS "Spins (delta)"
FROM latest AS l
JOIN collect.v_spinlock_stats AS t
  ON t.server_id = l.server_id
 AND t.collection_time = l.mx
ORDER BY t.delta_collisions DESC, t.collisions DESC
LIMIT 20
